name: cli-session-warning-transport
body: A write-time advisory is raised inside the mutation builder when the change is built — the node add/update wording advisory from the shared wording classifier, or the node rm outstanding-feedback notice naming each open or actioned Feedback item. On the session path the advisory travels in the session reply alongside the change output; the caller prints it on its stderr at the mutation and the write completes. The advisory informs the author and leaves the write result unchanged.
